answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the ferrous of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The dune holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
